sources: Originally written by xmetal (github.com/xmetal/infinite-hike, commit 4ec10c4, 2026-11-19). The repository has no licence file; used with the author's written permission (2026-11-21). Title font: Barrio (SIL Open Font License 1.1), a cut-down copy embedded in the game file by its author
Landscape, plants, animals and sounds are all generated in the browser; no image or sound files
